text: 7.  In certain regions of East and Central Africa, residents maintain a strict cultural practice of ironing every piece of laundry, including undergarments. This is a preventative measure against a specific fly that lays its eggs on damp clothing left out to dry. If the clothes are worn without being heat-treated, the larvae hatch and burrow into the skin to form painful, boil-like bumps. What is the name of this fly?
Where did it come from where did it go.
